note: Independent re-audit against RFC 8050 Section 4.2 ('These fields continue to encapsulate the raw and additional-path-enabled AFI/SAFI/NLRI in the record, and the raw attributes in the RIB Entries. For clarity, the RIB Entries in this subtype are not redefined.') at HEAD. dumpRIBForMRT walks IterateFamilyWire so generic families (including labeled unicast with RFC 8277 label stacks) keep raw wire NLRI; writeTableDumpV2 writes subtype 12 via WriteRIBGenericHeaderAddPath (4-byte PathID ahead of raw NLRI) with entryAddPath=false so RIB Entries remain unredefined. End-to-end RIB->MRT tests cover both FlowSpec (TestRFC8050MRTDumpGenericWithAddPath / WithoutAddPath) and labeled unicast (TestRFC8050MRTDumpLabeledGenericWithAddPath / WithoutAddPath), asserting subtype 12 vs 6, exact AFI/SAFI/NLRI bytes (with/without PathID prefix), and exact RFC 6396 entry length (2+2+4+2+attrLen). TestRIBGenericAddPathRoundTrip and TestRIBGenericRoundTrip verify subtype 12 and 6 decode round-trips.
